name: skills-review-and-polish
description: Authoring-time linter and surgical fixer for AI customizations (skills, instructions, agents, prompts). Finds contradictions, ambiguities, coverage gaps, and structural problems, and offers safe one-click fixes.

skillsReviewAndPolish.provider.description: LLM provider. 'vscode-lm' uses your Copilot subscription (no API key). External providers require a key set via the 'Set API Key' command (stored in SecretStorage).

skillsReviewAndPolish.model.markdownDescription: Analysis model **id**. Use the _Skills Review: Select Analysis Model_ command — the picker shows the friendly name with its id as description. The id uniquely identifies one model (e.g. `claude-sonnet-4.6`, `gpt-5.4`, `gemini-3-flash-preview`). Empty = auto-select best available model.

skillsReviewAndPolish.modelDisplayName.markdownDescription: _(Read-only — set automatically by the model picker.)_ Friendly name of the currently selected analysis model, shown here so you can see what `skillsReviewAndPolish.model` refers to without re-opening the picker.

skillsReviewAndPolish.deepModel.description: Model for the contradictions/deep wave (needs stronger reasoning). Empty = same as analysis model.

skillsReviewAndPolish.fixModel.description: Model for surgical fixes. A reasoning model is recommended. Empty = same as analysis model.

skillsReviewAndPolish.analysisMode.description: 'multiWave' runs 6 focused passes (best quality). 'single' runs one combined prompt (cheaper/faster).

skillsReviewAndPolish.scoreSamples.description: Number of analyzer scans to median for keep/revert fix decisions. Collapses the ~±6 penalty noise floor. Use 1 for cheap scans, 3 for fixing.

skillsReviewAndPolish.include.description: Glob patterns for files treated as AI customizations.

skillsReviewAndPolish.exclude.description: Glob patterns to exclude from analysis.

skillsReviewAndPolish.severityOverrides.description: Per-diagnostic-code severity overrides (ESLint-style). Map a code to error|warning|info|hint|off. Example: { "coverage-gap": "off", "contradiction": "error" }.

skillsReviewAndPolish.fixMode.description: 'diff' shows before/after for review; 'loop' auto-applies up to fixLoopMaxIterations; 'chat' hands off to Copilot Chat.

skillsReviewAndPolish.fixStrategy.description: 'subtractive' tightens by removing vagueness; 'additive' appends a concrete clause (append-only); 'improved' is scope-capped.

skillsReviewAndPolish.fixLoopMaxIteratio.description: Max fix-then-rescan iterations when fixMode is 'loop'.

skillsReviewAndPolish.fix.semanticCheck.description: Run an extra semantic-equivalence judge on each fix (extra API call).

skillsReviewAndPolish.fix.selfCritique.description: Audit each content-adding fix for fabricated facts (extra API call). Forced on for additive fixes.

skillsReviewAndPolish.fix.referenceGroun.description: Use a sibling references/ directory to ground factual fragments when fixing.

skillsReviewAndPolish.showScoreCodeLens.description: Show a CodeLens with the quality score and issue count at the top of customization files.

skillsReviewAndPolish.experimental.inlin.description: EXPERIMENTAL: preview surgical rewrites as inline ghost text on flagged lines.

skillsReviewAndPolish.logLevel.description: Set the verbosity for extension logging. 'debug' enables detailed LM prompt/response traces and the debug log file.

commands.title: Test Model with Simple JSON Prompt (Debug)

languageModelTools.name: skills-review-and-polish_analyze
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Analyzes an AI skill or instructions document for contradictions, ambiguities, coverage gaps, persona inconsistencies, and structural/hygiene issues. Returns a JSON array of diagnostics with codes, messages, severity, and line ranges.

text.description: The full text content of the skill/instructions document to analyze.

filePath.description: Optional absolute file path (used for domain hints and reference grounding).

languageModelTools.name: skills-review-and-polish_fix
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Surgically fixes a single identified issue in an AI skill or instructions document using safety-gated LLM rewriting. Returns the proposed fix text and risk flags for the caller to review.

relevantText.description: The exact verbatim text fragment to fix (the anchor).
